Hints: A negative base to an odd power results in a negative number
A negative base to an even power results in a positive number
10 is an even number, so the negative signs cancel out
Solution: An even number of negative signs multiplied together makes a positive. $(-1)^{10} = 1$.

Hints: 15 is an odd number, so one negative sign will be left over
Solution: An odd number of negative signs multiplied together makes a negative. $(-1)^{15} = -1$.
